titleTr: Mülakat tavsiyesi: should, ought to, had better

explainTr: 'Should' ve 'ought to' tavsiye verir: 'bence bu iyi bir fikir.' You should research the school. İkisi de aynı anlamdadır; 'should' günlük konuşmada daha yaygındır. Olumsuzu shouldn't (ought not to).
'Had better' daha güçlüdür: yapmazsan kötü bir sonuç olabilir. You had better arrive early. (Yoksa geç kalırsın.) Biçim olarak had better + yalın fiil; 'to' yoktur. Olumsuzu: had better not.
Üçünden sonra da yalın fiil gelir: should go, ought to go, had better go. Konuşmada 'had better' genelde 'd better diye kısaltılır: You'd better hurry.
grammar.compareTr: Türkçede tavsiye '-meli/-malı' ile verilir: gitmelisin, hazırlanmalısın. İngilizcede should (veya ought to) kullanırsın. 'Had better' ise 'gitsen iyi olur, yoksa...' gibi güçlü bir uyarıdır; 'had' burada geçmiş değildir.

reading.title: Advice for the interview
reading.text:
Hafsa's interview is on Thursday, and she wants to make a good impression. Last night she asked Linda for advice, because Linda once worked in human resources.

"First, you should research the school," Linda said. "Read its website and learn about its programs. The interviewers will be happy if you know something about them." Hafsa wrote it down.

"Second, you ought to prepare answers for common questions. They will probably ask about your strengths and weaknesses. You shouldn't say that you have no weaknesses. Be honest, but show how you are improving. For example, you can say, 'My English is not perfect yet, but I study every day.'" Hafsa smiled. That was easy to say, and it was true.

"Third, think about your clothes," Linda added. "You should wear something professional, like a jacket and nice shoes. And you had better arrive early. Being punctual shows respect. If you are late, they may think you are not serious."

Emre had one more tip. "Be polite and look at the interviewer. You shouldn't look at the floor. And if you feel nervous, take a deep breath before you answer." Hafsa laughed. "You are both telling me what to do!" "We want you to get the job," said Linda.

That night, Hafsa practiced in front of the mirror. She felt more confident than before. She knew that she should avoid long, difficult sentences and just speak clearly. If she made a mistake, she could simply smile and try again.

She should be honest and show how she is improving.
questions.whyTr: Metin: 'Be honest, but show how you are improving.'

questions.q: Why had Hafsa better arrive early?
What does Emre say to do if she feels nervous?
options: Take a deep breath before answering
questions.whyTr: Metin: 'take a deep breath before you answer.'

writing.promptTr: Mülakata girecek bir arkadaşına e-posta ile tavsiye ver. should, shouldn't, ought to ve had better kullan (80-120 kelime).
writing.promptEn: Write an email to a friend who has a job interview. Give advice with should, shouldn't, ought to and had better.
writing.model: Dear Ali, I heard about your interview on Monday. Congratulations! Here is my advice. First, you should research the school and read its website. You ought to prepare answers for common questions, too. You had better arrive early, because being punctual makes a good impression. You shouldn't wear jeans, and you shouldn't look at your phone. If you feel nervous, take a deep breath. Be honest and polite, and don't forget to say thank you. Good luck! Your friend, Hafsa
checklistTr: Should / ought to / had better'dan sonra yalın fiil var mı?
En az bir olumsuz tavsiye (shouldn't / had better not) yazdın mı?
Selamlama ve kapanış cümlen var mı?

Dana has a job interview tomorrow. Her friend says, "You should arrive early. You shouldn't wear jeans. If you feel nervous, you'd better take a deep breath."

What does the friend say about jeans?
